date_note: Date is GO's announcement of 19 November (updated 20 November with the former GO Dine and JapanTaxi apps); Plaid says the unauthorized access was in the early hours of 13 November.
title: GO says user IDs of 11,224 people may have leaked after unauthorized access to contractor Plaid's KARTE
summary: GO says information that may have leaked from its contractor Plaid's KARTE platform is user IDs for 11,224 people of the GO app. An update adds the former GO Dine app (8,914 user IDs, 6,640 email addresses) and the former JapanTaxi app (company name, name, user ID and email address for 69 people). GO says the information alone cannot be used to log in to the GO app.
plain: GO says user IDs of 11,224 people may have leaked from its contractor Plaid's KARTE platform, plus data from two former apps. GO says the leaked information alone cannot be used to log in to the GO app.
exec: A taxi-app operator reports a possible leak of 11,224 user IDs via a contractor's marketing platform, plus data from two closed apps.
action: GO advises caution with suspicious emails, SMS or calls claiming to come from GO, and not opening unknown links or attachments or entering IDs or passwords.

sources.name: GO Inc. notice (19 Nov, updated 20 Nov 2026)

validation.note: GO's own notice and contractor Plaid's own notice read. Plaid says a vulnerability in internal processing on a publicly reachable route was exploited; no attacker named. Cybersecurity.com (Japan, 25 Nov) relays Nikkei's about 20,000 total, which GO's notice does not state; not used.

evidence.quote: 現時点で判明している漏洩した可能性のある情報は、11,224名分のユーザーIDとなります。
旧『GO Dine』アプリ　8,914名分のユーザーID、6,640名分のメールアドレス
旧『JapanTaxi』アプリ　69名分の会社名、氏名、ユーザーID、メールアドレス
